name: Arena of Survival
desc:
Arena of Survival

⚔️ Loot, Fight, and Survive!

🏆 Battle 23 other players, last one alive wins!

🌊 Survive deadly disasters!

🎮 Fully playable on mobile, tablet, computer and console!

Updates:
[09/01/26]
⛏️ Quarry Update
- New Map: Abandoned Quarry Arena (map contest winner!)
- New lobby!
- Punching is now default, Brawler perk buffs it!
- Game flow changes: empty water bottles, random barrier closing, less center loot
- Weapon balance pass, Storm Rider buff, mosquito disasters removed

Inspired by The Hunger Games by Suzanne Collins.
